description: This Rust source file implements a gRPC server for a DataBroker using the Tonic framework. It defines asynchronous methods for querying, setting, subscribing, and retrieving metadata about data points and metadata stored within the broker. The implementation emphasizes authorization, error handling, and stream processing.

classes.name: broker::DataBroker
classes.description: Implementation of the gRPC Broker service for data point management, including get, set, subscribe, and metadata retrieval methods.

methods.name: get_datapoints( &self, request: Request<proto::GetDatapointsRequest>, ) -> Result<Response<proto::GetDatapointsReply>, Status>
methods.description: Handles client requests to retrieve multiple datapoints, returning their current values or failure states.

methods.name: set_datapoints( &self, request: tonic::Request<proto::SetDatapointsRequest>, ) -> Result<tonic::Response<proto::SetDatapointsReply>, Status>
methods.description: Handles client requests to update datapoints. It verifies permissions and updates actuator entries.

methods.name: subscribe( &self, request: tonic::Request<proto::SubscribeRequest>, ) -> Result<tonic::Response<Self::SubscribeStream>, tonic::Status>
methods.description: Establishes a subscription stream based on a query, streaming data updates to clients.

methods.name: get_metadata( &self, request: tonic::Request<proto::GetMetadataRequest>, ) -> Result<tonic::Response<proto::GetMetadataReply>, tonic::Status>
methods.description: Retrieves metadata entries, either all or specified by names.
